name: Agua Marina
description: '''Agua Marina''' is a Peruvian [[Peruvian cumbia|cumbia]] band formed in [[Sechura]], [[Department of Piura]], in 1976 by the brothers José and Manuel Quiroga Querevalú. The group has become one of the prominent representatives of northern Peruvian cumbia, alongside acts such as [[Grupo 5]] and [[Armonía 10]]. Its national breakthrough came in the late 1990s with "Tu amor fue una mentira", which became one of the most widely played cumbia songs on Peruvian radio.
